{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean revenue: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter out QA orders (revenue = 999999.99)
real_sales = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Filter out refunded orders (status == 'refunded')
# Because refunded orders should not be counted as revenue
real_sales = real_sales[real_sales['status'] == 'completed']

# Check the number of real completed sales
print('Number of real completed sales after removing QA and refunded orders:', len(real_sales))

# Compute total revenue by channel
revenue_by_channel = real_sales.groupby('channel')['revenue_clean'].sum()

# Print the results
print('\nTotal revenue by channel (after removing QA and refunded orders):')
print(revenue_by_channel)"}
